title: asset-viewer config (asset-viewer.json or .asset-viewer/config.json)
description: Every path is relative to the project folder and uses /. The viewer also checks things a schema cannot (paths that leave the project, regex syntax, plugin keys against each plugin's manifest).

title.description: Page title and nav header (default: the project folder's name).

roots.description: Folders to list. A string is a path; an object adds a label that prefixes the folder names in the list ('' for none; default: the last path segment).

hide.description: Globs of project paths to hide from the list and from /files/. A pattern means that path or anything below it.

vfxFolders.description: A texture under a folder of this name is a VFX sheet (default: vfx).

glassNames.description: Regexes of mesh names drawn as glass; matched by the page with JavaScript's RegExp.

materials.description: Shared atlases: a glob of model paths -> mesh or material name ('*' for any other) -> the map set.

theme.description: A built-in theme name or the path of a .css file.

pluginDirs.description: Project folders holding plugins. Their Python code runs only with --trust-project-plugins.

plugins.description: A key turns the plugin on; its value is that plugin's config ('enabled': false turns it off).
